scope: Source-only public API regressions; Rust compile/discovery/execution not performed. No production changes, copies, include!, private access, worker or publication.

fixture_provenance.input: Only source-defined synthetic bytes: pattern(i)=(i*37+11)%251, fixed ASCII literals and generated boundary lengths. No archives, user files or external fixtures.
fixture_provenance.digest: SHA256 known-answer for ASCII abc: ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad. Rust expected bytes are independent of the production digest implementation.
fixture_provenance.filesystem: Future runs create mode-0700 runs/case-PID-counter exclusively below this test directory. File helpers create_new. Mutation cases intentionally alter only their own synthetic input. Root identity checked before cleanup; no Drop cleanup on failed assertions, so evidence remains. No hostile concurrent actor or same-UID deletion safety claim.
fixture_provenance.special_files: FIFO via existing libc::mkfifo, local Unix socket inode without accepting connections, directory, hard links, and symlinks inside each owned sandbox. No device node creation, system special files or mounts.

contracts.acquisition: Frozen source remains unchanged. All Rust tests use the actual path dependency and public API. Callback mutations occur synchronously at real capture checkpoints, not timing races.
contracts.success: Normal full-read accounting is 2*N+2 reserved, 2*N actual, N compared and 2*ceil(N/65536)+2 calls. EOF and failed attempt reservations are not refunded.
contracts.short_read: Truncating at the first Copying checkpoint forces a positive one-byte read followed by EOF. The offset-1 checkpoint proves accumulation; the final expected outcome is Changed(Length), not successful short-read completion.
contracts.replacement: Parent rename/replacement retains the old regular-file inode without re-resolving the caller path. Leaf replacement unlinks the old inode and therefore expects Unsupported(MultipleLinks) from the nlink!=1 guard. No original-path persistence guarantee.
contracts.cancellation: Opening/Pinned/Copying/Comparing/Finalizing cancellation and typed callback error preserve usage. Callback errors win over next source observation and expired checkpoint deadline. Finalizing-to-return race remains uncovered.
contracts.timing: Three deadline-priority cases use natural elapsed time after a 10 ms callback sleep against a 1 ms budget. They are not injected clocks, hard deadlines, scheduler/latency guarantees or worker cleanup proof.
contracts.panic: One intentional callback panic is caught; source content is checked. This is not fd-close or OS cleanup evidence.
contracts.send: One Rust test contains Send bounds for selected types; non-Send Rc callback E is separately preserved. No compile result until approved no-run. No universal 'static or Send E requirement is claimed.
contracts.privacy: FileSnapshot Debug is checked against bytes/path/digest/identity exposure. Other generic callback/error Debug output is not covered.
contracts.cleanup: Explicit sandbox finish on success; any panic/error/timeout leaves the case directory and stops later cases. No cleanup success inferred from Drop.
contracts.old_results: Existing 16 classification failures and seven unverified cases remain unchanged and are not counted in these 72 declarations.

unverified: Successful positive-short-read sequence, read EINTR/EIO/permission errno, allocator failure and arbitrary syscall fault injection: no public injection boundary; no production hook or private include added.
Device and block nodes, procfs substitution, kernel primitive absence, privileged mounts and malicious same-process fd reuse.
Changed(Identity) from a correctly pinned FD, deterministic standalone Changed(Metadata), full ABA/same-inode mutation exclusion, atomic point-in-time copy.
Cancellation after final callback before return, final-metadata native failure vs deadline precedence.
Opaque-constructor compile-fail checks, non-Linux runtime/Unsupported branch, Windows/VM, strict syscall timeout, fd leak/cleanup proof.
OS worker launch/identity/EOF/reap, publication/commit/durability; execveat EACCES and held probes stay deferred.

future_execution.gate: Separate fixed-head review required before any Rust compile/no-run/discovery/runtime or fixture syscall execution.
future_execution.order: Verify source+test hashes -> locked/offline no-run -> list --format terse -> validate every nonempty line and exact unique name set -> execute each exact name once, --test-threads=1 --nocapture.
future_execution.on_failure: Stop at first compile/discovery/test/nonzero/unknown result; preserve logs and residual paths. No source/expectation edits or repeats. Deadline expiry requests termination only of the harness-owned test child; failure to reap is a separate blocked result.
future_execution.limit_caveat: Parent timeout is observation/control, not a guarantee of interrupting uninterruptible kernel I/O. No worker isolation claim.
future_execution.records: Exact argv/cwd/env allowlist, exit/status, raw stdout/stderr SHA256, binary SHA256, exact discovered/executed/pass/fail/ignored/filtered sets, source/test hashes before/after. Runs and validation output remain local and excluded from PR.
future_execution.toolchain: Existing 1.99.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu explicitly selected; default stable lacks rustfmt. No toolchain installation or shared override.
future_execution.sandbox_precondition: Approved runner creates tests/rust-file-snapshot/runs with mode 0700 before tests, verifies no symlink and expected owner, and refuses leftover case directories. No sandbox or synthetic input has been created at source-only stage.

allowed: normal Python static checks and checker helper tests
static_validation.python_guard: Reject -O/PYTHONOPTIMIZE before argument parsing and file reads.
static_validation.manifest: SHA256SUMS enumerates every deliverable except itself; source-pins.json independently records all nine fixed production blobs/hashes.
static_validation.deps: Only production path dependency plus its existing libc version/features; no new registry package or feature. Cargo.lock must equal production packages plus test root.
